news.title: Free agent Bohm reaches 2-year deal with Royals, reports say
news.summary: Free agent third baseman Alec Bohm has agreed to a two-year deal with Kansas City, according to multiple reports.

news.title: Sources: Yankees hiring ex-Rays adviser Hyde as bench coach
news.summary: The New York Yankees are hiring Brandon Hyde as bench coach, sources told ESPN on Wednesday, going with a familiar foe as manager Aaron Boone's right-hand man.

news.title: Goldschmidt happy to reunite with Green, says Yanks stint prepared him for Mets
news.summary: Paul Goldschmidt knew Mets manager Andy Green from their time together with Arizona in 2015 and was eager make the move across town from the Yankees to reunite.

news.title: Ortiz's wife urged Guardians pitcher to 'delete the evidence,' texts say
news.summary: Guardians pitcher Luis Ortiz's wife told him to "delete the evidence" in texts sent after a game in which he allegedly rigged a pitch.

news.title: Sources: Cubs continue spending spree, add 2-time Japanese MVP Sato for $120M
news.summary: The Cubs reached a 6-year, $120 million agreement with Japanese INF/OF Teruaki Sato on Tuesday, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan.

news.title: Sources: Peralta stays in AL East, gets $125M deal to top Orioles rotation
news.summary: Freddy Peralta has agreed to a five-year, $125M deal with the Orioles, who have landed an ace starter after losing Trevor Rogers, sources told ESPN.

news.title: Sources: Japanese right-hander Taira, Blue Jays agree to 5-year, $80M deal
news.summary: Right-hander Kaima Taira and the Blue Jays have agreed to a five-year, $80 million deal with an opt-out after the third season, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan.

news.title: Sources: Reds catcher Stephenson staying on 3-year, $30 million deal
news.summary: The Reds are retaining catcher Tyler Stephenson on a three-year agreement worth $30 million, sources told ESPN.
